quarterly_data.quarter: Tri Chemical Laboratories annual securities report: FY2026 (04-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (February 1, 2025 - January 31, 2026) results, annual securities report: net sales JPY 23,883,175 thousand (+26.3% year on year), operating income JPY 5,902,226 thousand (+12.3%), ordinary income JPY 7,090,219 thousand (+7.7%, including equity-method investment income from Korean affiliate SK Tri Chem Co., Ltd.) and net income attributable to owners of parent JPY 5,515,240 thousand (+11.1%). Management attributes the sales growth to high demand for advanced logic and memory semiconductors driven by the spread of generative AI and expanding data-center investment, which raised shipments of the group's chemical materials, despite lower material demand from some customers in the Chinese market that improved their production efficiency. Gross profit rose 12.6% to JPY 9,019,010 thousand, but the gross margin fell from 42.4% to 37.8% as higher depreciation raised manufacturing costs; SG&A rose 13.1% to JPY 3,116,784 thousand, mainly on higher packing and freight costs. The company also revised selling prices in view of rising costs.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 net sales JPY 23,883,175 thousand (+26.3%); operating income JPY 5,902,226 thousand (+12.3%); gross margin 37.8% (prior 42.4%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Tri Chemical Laboratories annual securities report: FY2026 (04-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 against the rolling medium-term plan (annual securities report): net sales JPY 23,883 million versus a JPY 26,000 million plan and operating income JPY 5,902 million versus JPY 6,050 million; management states sales and operating income fell short of the initial plan mainly because some customers in the Chinese market improved their production efficiency, cutting material demand and the group's shipments below the initial forecast. Ordinary income (JPY 7,090 million vs JPY 6,900 million plan) and net income attributable to owners of parent (JPY 5,515 million vs JPY 5,000 million) beat the plan because Korean affiliate SK Tri Chem Co., Ltd. performed more firmly than initially assumed. Operating margin was 24.7% against a 23.3% plan.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 23,883 million vs plan JPY 26,000 million; operating income JPY 5,902 million vs plan JPY 6,050 million; operating margin 24.7% vs 23.3%

quarterly_data.quarter: Tri Chemical Laboratories annual securities report: FY2026 (04-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term plan (annual securities report): for the plan ending with the 51st fiscal year (year ending January 2029) the company targets net sales growth of about 33% over three years to JPY 31.7 billion, operating income of JPY 8.65 billion and an operating margin of about 25%. Management expects continued large-scale data-center investment and the spread of AI-equipped devices to expand semiconductor demand and with it demand for semiconductor-manufacturing chemical compounds. Regional plan: in Japan, expand production centred on the Minami-Alps site; in Taiwan, further strengthen production at the Taiwan subsidiary's Tongluo plant; in China, promote local sales through the Shanghai subsidiary and prepare the plant start-up of affiliate AD-Trichem (Anhui) Electronic Materials; in Korea, strengthen group synergy with affiliate SK Tri Chem Co., Ltd., improve efficiency and win new customers.
quarterly_data.figure: Year ending January 2029 targets: net sales JPY 31.7 billion (about +33% over three years); operating income JPY 8.65 billion; operating margin about 25%

quarterly_data.quarter: Tri Chemical Laboratories annual securities report: FY2026 (04-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex (annual securities report): FY2026 capital expenditure totalled JPY 8,155,748 thousand, mainly buildings and production equipment at the Minami-Alps site, the production base for new etching materials, where the company advanced evaluations, equipment expansion and certifications toward mass production. Planned major new facilities: head-office plant, Uenohara No. 2 plant and Annex building (Uenohara, Yamanashi) - buildings and production equipment, JPY 5,606,000 thousand, start February 2026, completion planned January 2029; Minami-Alps site (Minami-Alps, Yamanashi) - land, buildings and production equipment, JPY 4,528,000 thousand (JPY 210,000 thousand already paid), started March 2025, completion planned January 2029; Taiwan subsidiary's head-office plant (Tongluo, Miaoli) - production equipment, JPY 2,364,000 thousand, start February 2026, completion planned January 2029. The company does not state the capacity added, saying it is hard to calculate reasonably. It states the Taiwan subsidiary's plant has reached full-scale operation and become a more important production base, which it says reduced transport costs and let it meet Taiwanese semiconductor makers' expectations.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 capex JPY 8,155,748 thousand; planned JPY 5,606,000 thousand (Uenohara), JPY 4,528,000 thousand (Minami-Alps), JPY 2,364,000 thousand (Taiwan), all completing January 2029
